coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth variables (45%): FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit precision, prefill time, decoding time, peak memory usage, and phase-specific speedup factors.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Instead of holding LLaMA-2-7B fixed, the design varies model size. It does not preserve e2e/benchmark.py and its internal methodology. Batch size 1 and prefill length 2048 appear only within broader sweeps rather than as the specified settings, and generation uses 256 tokens instead of 32 decode steps. Combined prefill-plus-decode execution time is omitted. Additional baselines and speculative performance claims also depart from the reference design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output field is empty, so it does not semantically match the reference conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied comparing QuaRot 4-bit and FP16 prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, and speedup for each phase.
